hv_source.author: Georgios K. Folas
hv_source.title: Modeling of Complex Mixtures Containing Hydrogen Bonding Molecules
hv_source.convention: SRK infinite-pressure Huron-Vidal with volume-weighted modified NRTL; tau12=(g12-g22)/(RT)=D12/T; tau21=(g21-g11)/(RT)=D21/T
hv_source.coefficient_units: D12 and D21 kelvin; alpha dimensionless; both temperature offsets zero
hv_source.qualification: Polar pure components use Mathias-Copeman alpha. Complete original pure-component configuration must accompany coefficients. These are not ordinary low-pressure NRTL parameters.

pure_component_sources.source_title: Samer Omar Derawi, Modeling of Phase Equilibria Containing Associating Fluids, 2002

pure_component_sources.water_caution: Folas chapter6 uses Pedersen1996 water MC values. Folas Table2.8 values1.0873,-0.6377,0.6345 are for SRK/MHV2 and must not silently be assumed identical to chapter6 configuration.

MEG_heptane_physical_reproduction.measurement_basis: Table reports100*mass_fraction. Values below divided by100; no mole-fraction interpretation.
MEG_heptane_physical_reproduction.measurement_uncertainty: MEG2% and hydrocarbon5% relative as stated immediately before Table3.3; model deviations exceed these uncertainties.
MEG_heptane_physical_reproduction.model_configuration: SystemSrkEos,rule4,multiphasecheck,MEG/n-heptane .5/.5mol; apply both directedClassicOrHV flags=HV; alpha.13;D12=430,D21=2595;DT12=DT21=0 on all allocated phases; MEGPC82bar and attractiveTerm4 MC1.1121,.9679,-1.4200 on all phases; default n-heptane pureproperties.
MEG_heptane_physical_reproduction.interpretation: Reproduces the published model correlation; not measurement-uncertainty accuracy. Current globalMEGPC90bar is incompatible with this fitted dataset; no global default changed.

numerical_qualification.checks: All five native ThermodynamicModelTest identities at 1e-8; checkNumerically at 1e-6 with byte-identical source serialization; independent fixed-composition liquid T differences at h=0.001/0.0005 K
numerical_qualification.history: Both component orders; 315.95,315.95,329.75,351.85,315.95 K against fresh controls
numerical_qualification.scope: Numerical consistency of the explicit source-paired SRK configuration; physical errors remain above reported measurement uncertainties

source_paired_pure_MEG_assessment.parameter_source: Already catalogued Derawi2002 Tables4.1/5.5; same MEG pure configuration as MEG_heptane_physical_reproduction; no refit
source_paired_pure_MEG_assessment.numerical_basis: Pure coexistence only: original bubble beta0=1e-10; use equal 0.5/0.5 phase amounts at unchanged saturation pressure to resolve native mole differences. No mixed-phase fraction is adjusted.
source_paired_pure_MEG_assessment.qualification: All native identities and numerical checks asserted. Point pressure comparisons do not propagate input or fitted-parameter uncertainty and do not qualify mixture partition, PR transfer, hydrates or library defaults.

PR_water_gas_source.table: Table1, printed page41, PDF page5; visually verified with earlier primary Yushchenko2015 Table1 printed76
PR_water_gas_source.convention: PR infinite-pressure covolume-weighted modified NRTL; tau12=D12/T+DT12 and tau21=D21/T+DT21
PR_water_gas_source.qualification: Staged research only. Exact source Tc/Pc/omega unresolved; library pure properties in executable assessment are explicit transfer assumptions. No default activation. Source expanded gamma equation15 has an inner-index inconsistency and PR log denominator13 a sign inconsistency; derive from GE/cubic rather than copying these expressions.
PR_water_gas_source.pure_alpha: [1+m(1-sqrt(T/Tc))]^2; m=.37464+1.54226w-.26992w^2 for w<=.49, otherwise .3796+1.485w-.1644w^2+.01667w^3. Post-equilibrium volume shift does not affect fugacity.

nitrogen_water_assessment.uncertainty: NIST compiler expanded95% absolute mole-fraction uncertainty; original table images remain unverified
nitrogen_water_assessment.protocol: Separate binary flashes on declared synthetic equal-mole feed. No measured-feed or paired-tie-line inference. Current library pure properties retained. No experimental accuracy threshold.
nitrogen_water_assessment.scope: Only nitrogen/water has executable measured transfer diagnostics; other six PR tuples remain catalog-only and unqualified.
